entities.name: Municipalidad de San José
entities.researchNotes: Municipalidad de San José, the capital municipality. Large population (288K) with substantial budget. Research indicates they are not a VC firm but a municipal government focused on public services. However, they have connections to national AI strategy via MICITT.

painPoints: Complex coordination with national AI initiatives
Need for governance alignment with international standards
personalizationContext.tailoredHook: Alygn helps municipalities navigate AI governance and alignment—critical as Costa Rica implements its National AI Strategy. We can help San José establish frameworks for responsible AI deployment.
personalizationContext.recentNews: Costa Rica's National AI Strategy exists at national level via MICITT. Municipal governments may be key implementation partners.

entities.name: Municipalidad de Heredia
entities.researchNotes: Municipalidad de Heredia manages public investments in infrastructure. Known for internal audits on NICSP implementation and public investment processes. Active in transparency initiatives.

painPoints: Outdated internal financial reporting norms not aligned with international standards (NICSP)
Delays in NICSP implementation and policy approvals
Weaknesses in accounting norm adoption and project documentation
personalizationContext.tailoredHook: Heredia's focus on transparency and governance standards aligns with Alygn's mission. We can support municipal AI governance frameworks that complement your NICSP compliance efforts.
personalizationContext.recentNews: Conducts internal audits on special topics like NICSP implementation and public investment processes
